lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and all holders of its shares agreed not to sell or transfer shares for 180 days after sales of this offering begin. Some exceptions apply.

what: It is a Hong Kong agency that plans events, decorates shopping malls, and produces content and designs for marketing.
proceeds: It plans to spend about 30% on growing content production and hiring talent, 20% on expanding its event business to new areas, 20% on possible acquisitions, and 30% on working capital and general needs. It has not picked any acquisition targets.
risks: Rules on handling personal data in Hong Kong could be costly to follow and could harm the business.
New laws in the US or China could affect the company's ability to list its shares and hurt their price.
There are political risks in doing business in Hong Kong.
Changes in exchange rates could hurt the company's results and the value of an investment.
Limits on its Hong Kong subsidiary paying dividends to the parent could hurt the company's growth and its ability to fund the business.
